market.question: Will the highest temperature in Toronto be 14°C on May 3?

assessment.reasoning: Environment Canada forecast for Sunday May 3 in Toronto: high 13°C with mix of sun/cloud. The 14°C bucket is very close to point forecast; 13°C bucket likely captures the actual outcome. Single-degree buckets at the modal forecast still split probability across 12/13/14°C buckets so 14°C gets a moderate share.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast variance around 12-14°C; small drift puts max in 13 or 14 bucket.
